feedback.worked_solution:
Let's sketch the graph of $y=f(x)=5sin⁡(2x).$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13939267/assets/67f6ec4f72e7bd74ac9ae5fa0f195cda1e90e8d8e6fad1bf85944a3dfd17fdfb.png)

As $x$ increases to $\infty $, the graph oscillates between the values $y=-5$ and $y=5$ indefinitely. Therefore,

$$
{lim}_{x\to \,\infty }f(x)={lim}_{x\to \,\infty }5sin⁡(2x)=DNE.
$$
